n.quote: Sixty-two University of Notre Dame undergraduates participated ... in Experiment 1. ... Overall, each participant performed 256 trials that were pre- ... sented in a set of 4 blocks of 64 trials each. ... reported_success.quote: Surprisingly, Experiment 1 failed ... to replicate the original finding of Abrams et al. (2008), with ... no significant difference in the set size effects between the lap ... and screen postures.

notes: Identity verified from supplied text: title Determinants of attentional modulation near the hands; Holger Schultheis and Laura A. Carlson; DOI 10.3389/fpsyg.2013.00858; ORIGINAL RESEARCH ARTICLE, published 18 November 2013. Canonical text is an 11-page primary article with methods, results and references, not an abstract or secondary account. No PDF was supplied. Experiment 1 has 62 participants, each completing the within-participant four-posture procedure. Response-time exclusions are trials only (incorrect responses and observations outside each individual/condition mean ±2.5 SD; 7% of trials). No participant exclusion is reported. The participant count is linked to the critical model by this complete within-participant procedure, not derived from degrees of freedom. Exact retained trial count is not reported. Only assigned unfinished fields are populated; all other statistic fields are placeholders. The narrative replication verdict is scoped to the original disengagement modulation. The set-size main effect is explicitly reported as F(1, 61) = 332.2, p < 0.001; these already-finished statistic fields are intentionally left as placeholders.
